name: Oc len
summary: Ốc len is a mangrove snail, on the town menu and at Hàng Dương as ốc len xào dừa.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, at chợ hải sản Hàng Dương.
howToEat: Order it with the seafood lunch. Thanh Niên’s named plate is ốc len xào dừa.
Dân Việt says 440,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking. Thanh Niên says 100,000 VND for a 700 g box of ốc len xào dừa on 11 Mar 2019.
where: Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, or the town streets.
seoTitle: Oc len — mangrove snail in Can Gio
seoDescription: Ốc len is a mangrove snail, including ốc len xào dừa at Hàng Dương.
